note: Promised minimum hours of power per day under NERC's service-based tariff (2020 MYTO, as revised). A band is marked verified only where the figure or its boundary appears in a NERC publication readable as text. NERC's full MYTO orders are PDF-only and could not be read by the build tooling, so the human must confirm every figure against the NERC order before release (power-log design section 2, R5.5). No figure here is invented: each carries its sources.

bands.name: Band A
bands.note: NERC's April 2024 Band A supplementary order sets Band A feeders' minimum service requirements; the 20-hour figure is reported by news outlets and awaits confirmation against the order text.

bands.name: Band B
bands.note: The 16-hour minimum is from news reports only; no readable NERC text confirms it.

bands.name: Band C
bands.note: NERC's 2021 public notice and 2020 press release state that bands D and E are served less than an average of 12 hours of supply per day, which places Band C's floor at 12 hours.

bands.name: Band D
bands.note: The NERC 2021 notice confirms only that Band D is served less than 12 hours per day; the exact 8-hour minimum is from news reports and awaits NERC confirmation.

bands.name: Band E
bands.note: The NERC 2021 notice confirms only that Band E is served less than 12 hours per day; the exact 4-hour minimum is from news reports and awaits NERC confirmation.
